direction: Every current shared header gets its own image directly tied to the page headline and purpose. Real city photographs and the service-area map retain their geographic context.

commonPrompt: Create ONE photorealistic illustrative construction editorial photograph for an Ontario/GTA specialty contractor website header. Wide landscape 16:9. Restrained realistic natural light, physically believable proportions, building materials, realistic hands and correctly contacting tools. Muted charcoal, warm brick and neutral tones with small construction-orange accents only where appropriate. Main action/material detail occupies centre-right, around 55–65% horizontal position, leaving quieter real contextual texture to the left for white headline overlay; it must remain legible in a centred narrow mobile crop. Avoid extreme panoramas, tiny distant subjects, theatrical posing, CGI gloss, oversaturated teal/orange, fisheye or dramatic motion. No writing, no text, no gibberish letters, no logos, no brand-labelled tools or clothing, no official certificates, badges or watermarks. Any papers/screens may have unlabeled diagrams and abstract gray lines only. PPE appropriate to the scene, people anonymous, no unsafe height work. Do not depict this as an actual Ascent project or employee. The page's title is context only and must NOT appear as text in the image. Subject:
